mapper.sql: p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.import_price AS product_import_price, p.selling_price AS product_selling_price, p.quantity AS product_quantity, p.description AS product_description, c.name AS product_category, p.created_at AS product_created_at
pi.id AS product_image_id, pi.url AS product_image_url, pi.public_id AS product_image_public_id, pi.product_id AS product_image_product_id

SELECT ,
FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON p.id = pi.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (name, import_price, selling_price, quantity, description, category_id) VALUES ( #{name}, #{importPrice}, #{sellingPrice}, #{quantity}, #{description}, (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{productCategory}) LIMIT 1) )
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0
